title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Prizm #73 Devonte' Graham Charlotte Hornets Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm trading card features Devonte' Graham of the Charlotte Hornets. The card is a part of the base set and has a card number of 73. It is a pink prizm parallel/variety and is not signed by the player. The card is perfect for collectors and fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA). 

The card is manufactured by Panini and is a part of the 2020-21 season. It is a sports trading card and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Get your hands on this card and add it to your collection today!
